prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1259; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with radiation into the trapezius region and low back pain with stiffness, worse on rising from a seated position. No loss of consciousness was reported. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness at the cervical and lumbar regions, reduced range of motion in cervical rotation and lumbar flexion, and muscle guarding without focal neurological deficit. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Treatment consisted of 19 visits over the course of care, including manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, and home exercise program instruction. Pain was managed with short-term over-the-counter analgesics and ice or heat application as tolerated. Progress was steady, with gradual improvement in range of motion, decreased pain intensity, and improved tolerance for daily activities and work duties.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported residual intermittent neck and back stiffness but was functioning well. Discharge to self-directed home exercise is recommended, with return precautions provided for any new numbness, weakness, or worsening pain.
